title: Identity join objects' record titles still splice raw lookup ids (sys_member, sys_two_factor, SCIM)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## What a reader sees

Four identity join objects build their `display_title` record title (their `nameField`) by concatenating stored lookup ids. A record page H1, a related-list Title column or a reference to any of these rows therefore shows raw ids instead of names:

| Object | Expression on main |
|---|---|
| `sys_member` (`identity/sys-member.object.ts:346`) | ``record.role != null ? record.user_id + ' (' + record.role + ')' : record.user_id`` |
| `sys_two_factor` (`identity/sys-two-factor.object.ts:171`) | ``'Two-factor for ' + record.user_id`` |
| `sys_scim_group_member` (`identity/sys-scim-group-member.object.ts:82`) | ``record.scim_user_id + ' in ' + record.group_id`` |
| `sys_scim_projection_grant` (`identity/sys-scim-projection-grant.object.ts:83`) | ``record.role + ' → ' + record.user_id`` |

## The precedent

`sys_business_unit_member` and `sys_team_member` (#30421, PR #30452) read their names one hop through the lookup, as allowed by the ADR-0079 addendum of 2026-10-18. Both use the form ``(isBlank(trim(record.user_id.name)) ? record.user_id.email : record.user_id.name)`` and are read under the reader's own authority, so an unreadable target gives a null title.

## Asks

- Rewrite each title to read names one hop through its lookups. For the SCIM objects, the dev should check which field on the target names it.
- For each lookup that a related list derives from, check whether it needs `relatedListColumns`, as #30421 did.
- Pin each title in `identity-display-title.test.ts`.

Found while reviewing #30421. The #30421 dev listed these objects in its report and left them unchanged.
